subject: Site visit changes
text: Hi, I need to adjust our site visit. The warehouse team flagged a loading issue. They cannot unload pallets until afternoon. We could meet them earlier. We can watch the handoff. If that fails, try the second shift. It should be calmer. I can book a van by noon. You can pick lunch near the depot. Text me if the plan changes. Bring your safety badge. I will carry the checklist. Thanks for staying flexible.
